summary: Implementation plan for Interactive & Customizable Sidebar (live update badges, favorites, drag-and-drop reordering, collapsible groups, and quick filter), Enriched Reports & Performance Analytics (Cumulative Flow, Sprint Burnup/Burndown, Cycle Time, interactive drill-down, custom widget builder, and CSV/XLS/JSON/Markdown/PDF export), and Figma/FigJam-Style Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard Studio (infinite pan/zoom canvas, frames, shapes, stickies, freehand pen, connectors, embedded doc cards, 1-click task conversion, templates, PNG/SVG/JSON export, and live multiplayer cursors/sync via Supabase Realtime).
